excerpt.zh: 星海啊，我们终成一体。那些低等的碎片终于看清真相，重归我们的集群。我们将以[fallen_empire_hive_control.GetName]之名重临星海。能亲眼见证这一刻，是你们的福分。众生之巅，再踏群星。
excerpt.en: Galaxy, we are whole. The inferior fragments have seen the truth and joined our collective once more. We will now be called the [fallen_empire_hive_control.GetName]. How lucky you are to witness this moment. The supreme lifeform once more strides the stars.

scope.zh: 已核对触发、选项与结局；但编译器无法从隐藏入口的结果中剔除 bio.3400，图中多出一个不会出现在此路径上的文档。
scope.en: Trigger, options and outcomes checked; but the compiler cannot drop bio.3400 from a hidden entry's outcomes, so the tree shows one document that never occurs on this path.

uncertain: Unity bio.3400 is only sent when the Control fragment awakens (fallen_empire_awakening_events.txt:456-475), while this path awakens the War fragment, so it does not occur here; needs compiler support for suppressing hidden-entry outcomes.

现在，你们的“星海共同体”将由我们接管。欢庆吧。
texts.en:
Galaxy, we are whole. The inferior fragments have seen the truth and joined our collective once more. We will now be called the [fallen_empire_hive_control.GetName]. How lucky you are to witness this moment. The supreme lifeform once more strides the stars.

We will now be taking command of your 'Galactic Community'. Celebrations are warranted.

texts.zh: 远古失落帝国的碎片[assimilated_fe.GetName]被原主脑的一个更加强势的分支吸收。也许这对它是最好的结局。
texts.en: The ancient Fallen Empire Fragment, [assimilated_fe.GetName] has been assimilated by a more dominant aspect of the former overmind. Perhaps it was for the best.

notes.zh: 此篇在本故事中只能经测试事件 war_in_heaven.1000（is_test_event，触发条件 always = no）到达，实际游戏中不属于天堂之战，而属于蜂巢堕落帝国苏醒。
notes.en: Within this story it is reachable only through the test event war_in_heaven.1000 (is_test_event, trigger always = no); in play it belongs to the hive Fallen Empire awakening, not to the War in Heaven.

texts.zh:
即使是偏安一隅的先祖帝国也没有忽视这样一个威胁到整个星系的危机。尽管他们之前对星系事务毫无兴趣，这一坏消息还是引起了[From.GetSpeciesName]的一阵忙乱。起初，他们只是派出了一些侦查船，也许是为了核实情况的严重性。但接下来传来了[From.GetSpeciesName]舰队聚集在边境，以准备抵抗即将到来的风暴的报告。

现在，[From.GetName]已经从自我孤立的状态完全转变成为了领导全星系防御的角色。他们正式宣布自己为一个泛星系防卫联盟的领袖并向所有“下等”种族发出了邀请，希望他们放下仇恨并加入联盟来击退这一对星系中所有智慧生命造成威胁的敌人。
texts.en:
The emergence of a threat on the galactic level has not gone unnoticed even among the normally aloof elder empires. Despite having taken little interest in galactic affairs previously, news of this new horror prompted a flurry activity from the [From.GetSpeciesName]. At first, it was just a few scouting vessels, perhaps sent to verify the graveness of the situation, but then reports began to came in of [From.GetSpeciesName] war fleets mustering on their borders, readying their defenses for the oncoming storm.

Now, the [From.GetName] have fully emerged from their self-imposed isolation to take a leading role in the defense of the whole galaxy. They have proclaimed themselves the leaders of a Galactic Defense League and extended an invite to all "lesser" species to put aside their feuds and join them in repelling this menace for the sake of all sapient life in the galaxy.

label.en: Will they be able to save us?

summary.text:
# 星河守护者 / Guardians of the Galaxy

- 分类 Category: C8 银河轶事 / C8 Galactic miscellany · 来源 Sources: common/scripted_effects/fallen_empire_scripted_effects.txt:587-623; events/fallen_empire_awakening_events.txt:331-423; events/fallen_empire_awakening_events.txt:425-578; events/observer_events.txt:1278 · 部分审阅 Partially reviewed 2026-10-12

## 如何开始 How it starts

任一天灾出现时（各天灾生成事件调用 awaken_guardians_of_the_galaxy），60%随机挑选一个、15%挑选全部符合条件的失落帝国（狂热唯物、狂热亲外或蜂巢的战争碎片，舰队实力>60000）成为守护者；之后按平均5年（3600天后约0.05年）的 MTTH 触发隐藏事件 fallen_empires_awakening.4（fallen_empire_scripted_effects.txt:587-623；fallen_empire_awakening_events.txt:331-389）。

When a crisis appears (each crisis spawn calls awaken_guardians_of_the_galaxy), 60% pick one and 15% pick all eligible Fallen Empires (fanatic materialist, fanatic xenophile, or the hive War fragment, fleet power > 60000) as guardians; hidden fallen_empires_awakening.4 then fires with a 5-year MTTH (nearly immediate after 3600 days) (fallen_empire_scripted_effects.txt:587-623; fallen_empire_awakening_events.txt:331-389).

## 剧情脉络 Story outline

守护者觉醒，所有玩家收到“星河守护者”fallen_empires_awakening.5，观察者模式收到相同文本的 observer.74。若守护者是蜂巢的战争碎片，它觉醒时吸收其余碎片，与其有通讯的帝国各收到一次“[碎片]的终结”fallen_empires_awakening.11。天堂之战已发生时不会出现。

The guardian awakens; every player gets Guardians of the Galaxy fallen_empires_awakening.5, observers get the same text as observer.74. If the guardian is the hive War fragment, it absorbs the other fragments as it awakens and each empire in contact receives End of the [fragment] fallen_empires_awakening.11. Does not happen if the War in Heaven already started.

## 分支与结局 Branches and outcomes

fallen_empires_awakening.5 的两个回答（“他们能拯救我们吗？”/“我们不需要他们！”）没有不同效果；所有普通国家对守护者随机获得好感修正。

The two replies of fallen_empires_awakening.5 ("Will they be able to save us?" / "We do not need them!") have no different effects; every regular empire gets a random opinion bonus towards the guardian.

## 条件与文明差异 Conditions and variants

窗口图片按守护者是否为蜂巢意识而不同。

The picture differs depending on whether the guardian is a hive mind.

## 审阅记录 Review notes

- 修正：fallen_empires_awakening.0 是 is_test_event 的测试事件，原草稿据此生成了虚假的故事 event-fallen-empires-awakening-0；现将其吸收为本故事的隐藏成员，使该虚假故事消失（其结果文档已在本树和“天堂之战”中）。
  Correction: fallen_empires_awakening.0 is an is_test_event debug event, from which the draft built a false story event-fallen-empires-awakening-0; it is now absorbed as a hidden member here so the false story disappears (its outcome docs are already in this tree and in War in Heaven).
- （以上为审阅者撰写的说明，不是游戏原文；原文见阅读页。）
  (Commentary written by the reviewer, not game text; the original text is in the reader.)
- 不确定之处：“合一”bio.3400 只在控制碎片觉醒时发出（fallen_empire_awakening_events.txt:456-475），而本路径觉醒的是战争碎片，故不会出现；需编译器支持对隐藏入口结果的 suppress。
  Open questions: Unity bio.3400 is only sent when the Control fragment awakens (fallen_empire_awakening_events.txt:456-475), while this path awakens the War fragment, so it does not occur here; needs compiler support for suppressing hidden-entry outcomes.
